title: Workshop: untangle a stylesheet
summary: Replace ID chains, a loaded !important and fragile selectors with flat single classes, one rule at a time.
intro: a small pricing card with a stylesheet that works but is tangled: every rule hangs off the `#app` ID, there is a rogue `!important`, and the featured style depends on `:first-child`. The HTML already carries sensible classes (see the html tab). In each step you replace one heavy selector with a single class and change one value, so the new rule is the only one that applies. By the end, nothing in the stylesheet is heavier than `(0, 1, 0)`.
